summary: [Gmail] capabilities: Read: list/get messages & threads, search (Gmail query syntax), history.list, attachments.get. Write: messages.send (raw RFC822 base64url), drafts create/update/delete/send, labels/filters/settings management, messages modify (labels), trash/untrash, batchDelete/batchModify. Sending also metered by account Gmail sending limits, separate from API quota.
